description:
REFUTED 2026-09-16 by probe on 549c3b05d (research agent, json_roundtrip, release build; prototypes reverted). The idea was: AnalyzeActivation reads a callee's ReturnType as Current (jobs/semantic.rs prepare_function_call); a caller outside the callee's DeriveCallGraphComponent could read it Settled and skip the return ladder's rungs. Two independent failures.

1. The membership test is unsound. DeriveCallGraphComponent walks StaticCallees (keying.rs collect_step_edges / collect_tail_edges), which emits edges only for LoweredTail::DirectCall and LoweredStep::Lambda; ClosureCall, Dispatch and FunctionRef emit none and protocol callbacks are static leaves. AnalyzeActivation reads ReturnType through exactly those edges (resolve_closure_call and resolve_protocol_call both reach prepare_function_call). Reproducer, three singleton components mutually recursive through &fun/1 values: defp call(f, n), do: f.(n); defp ping(n), do: if n <= 0, do: 0, else: call(&pong/1, n - 1); defp pong(n), do: if n <= 0, do: 1, else: call(&ping/1, n - 1); def main(), do: dbg(ping(4)). Baseline prints 0; with the settled read it ends Unresolved with a printed four-cycle of Settled(ReturnType) waits. A sound relation would be mutual reachability over the ReturnType read graph, which is derived by the analysis being gated.

2. Where the test is sound the change regresses. A Settled read needs a Settled wait (a read alone leaves the reader unfinal forever; measured: product path exceeded fact-wait budget). With the wait, on json_roundtrip: AnalyzeActivation runs 1476 -> 3856 (2209 blocked, 56% of span time), main/0 51 productive -> 2 productive but 117 blocked full-body walks, Json.decode_done/2 36 -> 615, run wall 0.39s -> 0.67s, backend dump byte-identical. Mechanism: content ascends monotonically but settled readiness oscillates; each drain certification wakes every Settled subscriber, most re-walk and block, re-dirty their claims and un-settle their readers. cargo test --lib: 9 failed plus compiler2_redefining_main_retracts_the_old_root_frontier_and_activates_foo livelocked at 100% CPU in settle_quiescent_waits.

The ladder's echo is real (990 of 1193 AnalyzeActivation wakes are ReturnType, 424 of them cross-component) but the cure is shortening the ladder: fz-kdt.177. The StaticCallees blind spot is recorded on fz-kdt.98.
title: A caller outside a recursive group is re-analyzed on every rung of the group's return ladder
